scalar_field: Exact rational arithmetic; the same finite matrices hold over R and C
scope: Own rows use four independent existing two-source partials per tetrahedron. Each output component is restored once. Existing face functions may be jointly refactored before this restoration, but their disjoint SOURCE supports cannot cancel outside the component cap. Center totals use only early retired donors, plus one optimistic new carrier per missing scalar direction. The fixed 16-helper factory and 12 second face copies remain. This is a necessary feasibility and inventory screen, not a lower bound for arbitrary interleaved words.
